description: Delfelt vannkraft is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. Database over nedbørfelt (def. i REGINE) som drenerer til et vanninntak for kraftproduksjon. Egenskapsdata er delfeltnr., delfeltnavn, navn og nr. på tilhørende vannkraftverk, areal, middel årtilsig og nedenforliggende delfelt. Coverage: Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. The publisher named on the listing is Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat. Its keywords include Norge digitalt, Annet, delfelt vannkraft, vannkraft, fellesDatakatalog, Energi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in TXT, OCTET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
